configurePresets.name: competition
configurePresets.displayName: Competition image (Rev A default) - START HERE
configurePresets.description: What the car runs on race day: EZH camera capture, ER-TFT020-3 SPI LCD, session-gated USB telemetry, and QDC wheel-speed feedback. Build this unless you have a reason not to.

configurePresets.name: camera-usb-bench
configurePresets.displayName: Bare FRDM EZH camera + USB preview (no shield/LCD)
configurePresets.description: Maintainer diagnostic for a directly wired camera: EZH capture, LCD disabled, forced non-moving race-waiting mode, session-gated USB telemetry, motors and encoders disabled.

configurePresets.name: encoders
configurePresets.description: Adds QDC wheel-speed feedback and the on-screen RPM readout. Same camera and display as the competition image.

configurePresets.name: flexio-port1
configurePresets.displayName: FlexIO camera capture on the Rev A wiring (needs 3 jumpers)
configurePresets.description: Frees the EZH. Requires the three J9_EXT jumpers: 12->32, 11->30, 15->2. See docs/research/AVC_Camera_FlexIO_Pin_Migration.md.

configurePresets.name: flexio-port4
configurePresets.displayName: FlexIO camera capture on the original Port 4 pins (needs 11 fly-wires)
configurePresets.description: The original FlexIO pin group. Build-verified but not hardware-verified since the pin-group refactor.

configurePresets.name: servo-p3-20
configurePresets.displayName: Competition image with the Rev B servo pin (P3_20)
configurePresets.description: Drives the servo from P3_20/PWM1_A3 on shield J1.5 instead of P2_3. For scoping the Rev B candidate.

configurePresets.name: encoder-diag
configurePresets.description: RTT-only encoder diagnostic. Skips camera and LCD startup. Safe to turn wheels by hand.

configurePresets.name: encoder-diag-motors
configurePresets.displayName: Encoder bench diagnostic, MOTORS ON - car must be on blocks
configurePresets.description: Drives both motors at 10 percent duty, auto-starting 4s after boot. Duty is capped at 20 percent by an #error. Put the car on blocks.
